props.title: Kuwait air-defence site
props.caption: Kuwait, where an explosion followed a drone attack and two Italian technicians died.
Bangchak’s Phra Khanong refinery remains shut pending safety inspections.
Huawei and three subsidiaries were convicted after a three-month trial.

items.note: Italy said an explosion followed a drone attack at a Kuwaiti air-defence site where two technicians died.
Thailand’s Industry Ministry suspended all four refining units at Bangchak’s Phra Khanong refinery pending safety inspections.
A federal jury in the Eastern District of New York convicted Huawei and three subsidiaries after a three-month trial.

lead.what: Italy said an explosion followed a drone attack at a Kuwaiti air-defence site where two technicians died; Iran denied involvement.

rest.what: Venezuela’s possible OPEC exit has been discussed with U.S. officials, but no final decision has been made before the 29 November meeting.

lead.what: Thailand suspended all four refining units at Bangchak’s Phra Khanong refinery pending safety inspections.

rest.what: The United States proposed tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods, with a 17% rate if the countries conclude a trade deal.

lead.what: A federal jury convicted Huawei and three subsidiaries after a three-month trial covering Iran sanctions, bank deception, money laundering and trade-secret theft.

rest.what: A Commons debate and expected vote on 7 December concern a bill to implement UK-EU food-and-drink and emissions agreements.
